overview: The board approved a special permit for a second dwelling at 70 Lincoln Road and finalized its recommendation to the City Council regarding the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District zoning amendment.

items.title: 70 Lincoln Road Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit to construct a second single-family structure on a lot with an existing home, with conditions requiring a tree replacement plan and the construction of a sidewalk to city standards.

items.title: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning
items.summary: Voted to recommend the zoning amendment to the City Council as amended, which included correcting mapping for the St. Clement's property and establishing use standards for purpose-built student housing. The board forwarded a split recommendation specifically regarding whether the sixth-story step-back on North Street should be 10 feet or 60 feet.

items.title: Administrative Continuances
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on zoning amendments for vacant and foreclosed properties and the approval of past meeting minutes to September 16, 2026.
